description.describe_ch: 《現代藝術的創意體驗》讓初次接觸藝術的同學透過簡單的小練習與深入淺出的理論介紹，來了解與體驗現代藝術的精神內涵。課程將啟發學生從不同的角度探索現代藝術中的四個主題，分別是超現實藝術、包浩斯美學、現代攝影、行為藝術。藉由觀察作品的形式、內容、與簡單地體驗創作和思考的過程，進而思考現代藝術家的創作意圖與所呈現的文化訊息。
description.describe_eh: "Creative Experience of Modern Art" allows students who are new to art to understand and experience the spiritual connotation of modern art through simple exercises and in-depth theoretical introductions. The course will inspire students to explore four themes in modern art from different perspectives, namely Surrealist art, Bauhaus aesthetics, modern photography, and performance art. By observing the form and content of the works, and experiencing the creative process, students can contemplate the creative intentions of modern artists and the cultural messages they present.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 引導學生了解現代藝術的形式、內容與背景。
courseBankC.describe_en: Guide students to understand the form, content and context of modern art.
courseBankC.core_item: 知識探索：能培養多元領域學習的興趣；能統整跨領域的知識；能持續從事跨領域的學習。
courseBankC.core_eng: Knowledge Pursuit：To integrate extensive interests, curiosities and literacy of multidisciplinary knowledge and internalize one’s won viewpoints.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 啟發學生對藝術內涵的思考。
courseBankC.describe_en: Inspire students to contemplate the connotation of art.
courseBankC.core_item: 批判思考：能跳脫框架、從不同角度看問題、並能客觀分析不同觀點的利弊得失、能理性評估後做出客觀判斷。
courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking: Ability to jump out of the framework, look at issues from different angles, objectively analyze the pros and cons of different viewpoints, and make objective judgments after rational evaluation.
